description: Married filing jointly, full-year California residents; one W-2 ($28,000 wages, $1,000 federal withholding, $28,000 California wages in Box 16, $200 California withholding in Box 17); two dependents, ages 5 and 3, both with SSNs and 12 months lived with the taxpayer; identity stored for both spouses (DOBs 1993/1995). California: MFJ standard deduction, exemption credits zero out the small Tax Table tax, and the refund is the California EITC from the FTB 3514 table plus the Young Child Tax Credit (one credit per return for the under-6 children) plus withholding. Money values below are integer cents.
